pages.text: Water above a dripstone block allows the pointed stone below to grow. The mimic remembers that growth, rather than merely breaking a piece away.

pages.title: Shaping the Pattern
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)Dripstone Block$(br)Water Bucket$(br)Pointed Dripstone$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation$(br)Rune Plate: Sequence and Delay$(br)Rune Plate: Numbers and Chance
